verdicts.reason: A: the middle column is too narrow, so the tagline and venue break awkwardly ('sundown, / Harbour / Rooftop, Pier 9'). 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has shrunk to an illegible scrap wedged beside the logo. RSVP is the same size as the FREE ENTRY pill, which buries the CTA, and the pills sit in a ragged 2x2 grid. B: the large 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' almost touches 'Saturday 21 June', and the missing-asset placeholder box sits prominently in the middle of the canvas. 'Reserve a spot' has become illegible fine print, and the bottom right is left as dead space, so B ends up slightly worse.
